description: Create a Premium Monitoring Dashboard in React (Vite) for the Auto Content Factory. Design: Sleek Dark Mode, Glassmorphism, Neon Accents (No Purple). Features: 1. Health check status (CPU/Mem/Disk) from /maintenance/health. 2. Scraping Logs overview. 3. Video generation performance chart. 4. n8n workflow integration status. Use modern UI libraries like Framer Motion and Lucide-react.
